notes: Card flags the pole broad (1.3%). Top examples are words inside Title-Case headings (' Works', ' Move', ' Benefits', ' Can', ' Your'); the output promotes capitalised word starts. Probes: headlines 0.26-0.81 (peaks on ' Move', ' Benefits', ' Works', ' To', ' Make', ' May'), the same content in sentence case 0.02-0.05, proper names in prose 0.01.
